**The build passes now.** You were right, some of it was real.

The bump changed two things your code still read the old way:

1. `src/core/options.js` looked for `options.retries`. The new name is `retryCount`, so it read nothing and crashed.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` demanded a real `true` or `false`. Unset flags now come back empty, so it threw.

Both now accept the new shape and the old one. Backoff stays off when unset, same as before.

The 8 warnings left are the old-API notices, like `Buffer()` and `punycode`. They don't break the build. I can clean those up next if you want.
